title: GTA 6 Release Nears: How Gamers Spend the Final Weekend
description: We are officially in the GTA 6 evacuation zone with less than two weeks to go. See how gaming media is passing the time this weekend.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The GTA 6 Evacuation Zone: Passing the Final Weekend

Another week has come to a conclusion, and the gaming community is very much in the GTA 6 evacuation zone now. With less than two weeks until Rockstar's monumental sequel drops, gamers and media alike are finding unique ways to kill time while the anticipation reaches fever pitch.

### Clearing the Backlog Before the Storm

As shared by gaming media outlet Push Square, editor Jamie O'Neill is taking the opportunity to chip away at a gaming backlog. Having only managed about three hours on *Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut*, O'Neill plans to break out the PS Vita this weekend. The reasoning? He simply can't leave that masked protagonist stuck in a disease-riddled city a moment longer before the monumental shift in gaming attention that the new Rockstar sequel will undoubtedly bring.

This phenomenon of frantically trying to finish older or smaller titles right before a massive industry-shaking release is a familiar ritual for many enthusiasts. It represents the calm before the storm, a fleeting moment to tie up loose ends in virtual worlds before being completely consumed by the streets of Vice City and beyond.

### The Final Stretch

Whether you are dusting off a portable console like the PS Vita or diving into a lengthy RPG, the goal this weekend is purely to pass the time until the official launch. The excitement surrounding the sequel is palpable across the entire industry.

## Editor's Take

With less than two weeks left until Rockstar's sequel arrives, diving into backlog titles like *Lone Survivor* on the PS Vita is a brilliant way to stay occupied. Enjoy the final quiet weekend before the massive wave of GTA 6 completely takes over our lives.
